description: `--help` is what a reader types when they do not yet know the grammar, so it cannot be an error against that grammar: the usage goes to stdout, alone, and the run succeeds. Asking for it after a command is the same request and gets the same answer. Naming no command at all is the different thing — nothing was asked for — and stays a usage error on stderr.

names: nothrow — statically enforce that no throw escapes a @nothrow function
